question.text: The magnetic flux <math xmlns="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML"><mi>ϕ</mi></math> (in weber) linked with a closed circuit of resistance <math xmlns="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML"><mn>8</mn><mo> </mo><mi>Ω</mi></math> varies with time (in seconds) as <math xmlns="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML"><mi>ϕ</mi><mo>=</mo><mn>5</mn><msup><mi>t</mi><mn>2</mn></msup><mo>−</mo><mn>36</mn><mi>t</mi><mo>+</mo><mn>1</mn></math>. The induced current in the circuit at <math xmlns="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML"><mi>t</mi><mo> </mo><mo>=</mo><mn>2</mn><mo> </mo><mi mathvariant="normal">s</mi></math> is _______ <math xmlns="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML"><mi mathvariant="normal">A</mi></math>.

solution.text:
Induced EMF is given by, ε=−dϕdt=10t−36

Now, it is given that at t=2 s, ε=16 V.

Therefore, i=εR=168=2 A
